steps.code:
# Now let me get the received transactions for this month so far
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction="received",
        min_created_at="2023-05-01",
        max_created_at="2023-05-18",
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total received transactions this month: {len(transactions)}")
for t in transactions:
    print(f"Amount: {t['amount']}, From: {t['sender']['name']}, Date: {t['created_at']}")
